explanation: Merges main (#92, #93) into the HypoMap atlas build. From main: pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides workbox-build>glob to 14.0.6 for the patched minimatch, and CONTEXT.md, the catalog and the AGENTS.md startup line describe the explorer screen (useExplorer.ts, ExplorerShell.tsx). From this branch: package.json adds build:hypomap and test:hypomap-build, .gitignore excludes data/hypomap/source/ and data/hypomap/build/, hypomap-release.json pins the reproducible hypomap-atlas-2026-11-26, the Application workflow runs the synthetic-H5AD exporter test, and PROJECT_GUIDANCE lists the HypoMap sources among files not in the repository.
